nodes.name: Platform Operator
nodes.description: Registers hosts and zones as Host and AvailabilityZone objects, creates each host's SSH Secret in the credentials namespace, and cordons hosts. Never runs commands on a hypervisor by hand once faubourg manages it.

nodes.name: VM Consumer
nodes.description: Requests VMs, pools or claims from banlieue and targets a zone with a providerSelector on the faubourg zone label (ADR-0003). Never sees faubourg objects.

nodes.name: faubourg
nodes.description: The control plane: inventory of hosts, grouping into availability zones, remote bootstrap, zone health. Ships no host agent and no VM scheduler (ADR-0002).

nodes.name: Host controller
nodes.description: The faubourg-controller Deployment in faubourg-system, one replica (ADR-0009). Reconciles Host: gates on the zone, applies the host's banlieue Provider (class, endpoint and labels for a bootstrapped host, labels only for an adopted one; never deletes one, ADR-0011), creates the bootstrap Job once banlieue has given the Provider its identity and when the Host's bootstrap inputs change (the pinned script digest among them), holding a re-bootstrap of an already-bootstrapped host until a rollout slot is free and halting the rollout at the first failure (ADR-0013), derives the phase from the Job and the Provider (ADR-0005, ADR-0007), and writes status by server-side apply. Never reads SSH Secrets, a script or any ConfigMap but the bootstrap policy parameters, never mints a token.

nodes.name: Zone controller (planned, roadmap 02)
nodes.description: Reconciles AvailabilityZone: rejects storage.mode Shared in v1 (ADR-0004), counts member hosts, publishes Ready.

nodes.name: Bootstrap Job
nodes.description: One Kubernetes Job per set of a Host's bootstrap inputs (ADR-0009 decision 6), in the credentials namespace (ADR-0005 decision 5). Runs faubourg-bootstrap (ADR-0010): one static Rust binary on russh in an image with no shell, digest-pinned. It refuses a mounted script whose sha256 is not the pinned FAUBOURG_SCRIPT_SHA256 before opening any connection (exit 66, ScriptUnpinned, ADR-0013), verifies the host key before authenticating (Strict whenever the Secret has knownHosts), checks the on-host script's owner, mode and sha256 with the scoped credential, places it and the sudo rule with the privileged placement credential only when it differs (else ScriptDrift), optionally revokes the placement key, then runs sudo -n /opt/faubourg/install.sh. Every command is a constant; data goes on stdin. Mints the host's first provider token through TokenRequest with its own 10-minute projected token, and hands it to the install script on stdin, never to the controller or a Secret (ADR-0011). Reports the host key fingerprint in its termination message (ADR-0005, ADR-0006, ADR-0008, ADR-0010).

nodes.name: Bootstrap admission policy
nodes.description: A ValidatingAdmissionPolicy and binding on the credentials namespace, evaluated by the Kubernetes API server. Every Job there must run the digest-pinned bootstrap image with no command, literal env, read-only credential volumes and a script volume whose source, key and FAUBOURG_SCRIPT_SHA256 match a pinned entry and the restricted security profile; only the Job controller may create Pods there. Parameters live in a ConfigMap in faubourg-system that neither the controller nor a script maintainer can write (ADR-0008, ADR-0013).

nodes.name: Bootstrap policy parameters (A-8)
nodes.description: The ConfigMap faubourg-bootstrap-policy in faubourg-system, written by the platform administrator: the bootstrap image's digest, and each allowed script source with its key and the sha256 of its content (ConfigMap/<name>/<key>@sha256:<hex>). The admission policy evaluates every Job against it; the Host controller reads it, and nothing else of its kind, to learn each script's pinned digest. A script maintainer cannot pin their own change (ADR-0008, ADR-0013).

nodes.name: Host and AvailabilityZone CRs
nodes.description: Cluster-scoped faubourg.firestoned.io/v1alpha1 objects; the Rust types in faubourg-api are the source of truth (ADR-0003).

nodes.name: Host SSH Secret
nodes.description: Root-equivalent bootstrap credential, one per host, in the credentials namespace. Key or SSH certificate preferred, password discouraged, knownHosts pins the host key (ADR-0006).

nodes.name: Kubernetes API server
nodes.description: The only transport between faubourg and banlieue: CRDs, Jobs, Leases.

nodes.name: banlieue
nodes.description: VM lifecycle platform. Its controller, scheduler and operator place VMs across Provider failure domains, read provider Leases, and run nothing on the hosts directly (banlieue ADR-0060, ADR-0098, ADR-0102).

nodes.name: banlieue Provider (one per host)
nodes.description: Class cloud-hypervisor. Created by faubourg with the zone, host and cordon labels it owns by field manager; its status (failure domain, capacity, Ready) is written by the host-resident provider (ADR-0003, ADR-0007). Created and labelled by faubourg for a bootstrapped host, labelled only for an adopted one (ADR-0011).

nodes.name: Cloud Hypervisor host
nodes.description: A bare-metal KVM machine prepared by banlieue host cloud-hypervisor install.

nodes.name: Install script source
nodes.description: ConfigMap or Secret holding install.sh, in the credentials namespace and on the admission policy's scriptSources allowlist with the sha256 of its content; an edit runs nowhere until the platform administrator pins it. The default downloads a pinned banlieue binary, verifies its sha256 and runs banlieue host cloud-hypervisor install (ADR-0005, ADR-0008, ADR-0013).

nodes.name: /opt/faubourg/install.sh
nodes.description: root:root 0755 under a root-owned directory; the scoped account's only sudo rule runs it with no arguments, and cannot write it (ADR-0005).

nodes.name: sshd
nodes.description: The host's SSH daemon. Reached only by bootstrap Jobs, and optionally closed to faubourg after bootstrap (ssh.revokeAfterBootstrap).

nodes.name: banlieue Cloud Hypervisor provider
nodes.description: Host-resident systemd service, outbound only to the Kubernetes API, supervising one cloud-hypervisor process per guest through template units (banlieue ADR-0060, ADR-0063). This is the host agent (ADR-0002).

nodes.name: cloud-hypervisor (one per VM)
nodes.description: The VMM, REST API on a local unix socket, started by the provider as a systemd template unit instance.

nodes.name: Host management network
nodes.description: The path from cluster nodes to each host's SSH port and from each host to the Kubernetes API. Exact topology is an open question (ADR-0005).

nodes.name: GitHub Container Registry
nodes.description: Holds faubourg-controller and faubourg-bootstrap, pushed only from main and releases, each Cosign-signed keyless by digest with build provenance and an SBOM (ADR-0012).

nodes.name: Install file (faubourg-<version>.yaml)
nodes.description: deploy/ rendered with both image digests by make release-manifests, Cosign-signed, attached to each release. The bootstrap digest is written into the admission policy's parameters and the controller's environment by the same render (ADR-0012).

relationships.description: faubourg is two reconcilers, the Jobs one of them creates and the admission policy that constrains those Jobs, guarding the inventory objects.
What runs on a prepared host.
banlieue's objects faubourg writes and reads.
Hosts sit on the management network.
The operator declares hosts, zones and SSH Secrets.
The consumer asks banlieue for VMs and may select a zone by label.

Watches Host, AvailabilityZone, its own Jobs (by owner UID) in the credentials namespace and Providers in banlieue's namespace; reads Pods there for a failed Job's exit code and a succeeded Job's host key fingerprint (ADR-0010 decision 8); creates and deletes Jobs; applies Host status. No Secret or ConfigMap access in the credentials namespace; every Job it creates passes the bootstrap admission policy (ADR-0008, ADR-0009).
The API server evaluates the policy on every Job and Pod create or update in the credentials namespace, before the object exists. Deny on failure.
The admission policy evaluates every Job with the parameters: the pinned image, and the pinned script source, key and digest (ADR-0008, ADR-0013).
The Host controller gets, lists and watches this one ConfigMap by name, read-only, to resolve each Host's script to its pinned digest (ADR-0013).
Watches AvailabilityZone and Host; writes AvailabilityZone status.
The Job's pod mounts exactly one host's Secret(s) as a read-only volume; the controller never fetches them, and the admission policy keeps any other image from mounting them (ADR-0008).
The Job mounts the script source, refuses it unless its sha256 is the pinned digest, and compares it with the on-host script.

SSH (CALM has no SSH protocol value). Strict host key verification (or recorded TOFU). Placement with the privileged credential when needed, then the one scoped sudo command; no CR field reaches a shell (ADR-0005). Host key verified before any authentication (ADR-0010 decision 4).
Outbound only: renews its Lease every 5 seconds and writes its Provider status and machines (banlieue ADR-0060, ADR-0102).
The VMM REST API over the guest's unix socket (banlieue ADR-0061).
banlieue's scheduler reads each Provider's failure domain, labels, capacity and heartbeat to place VMs (banlieue ADR-0098, ADR-0107).

Applies the host's Provider, named after the Host, by server-side apply: the zone, host, cordon and zone labels under faubourg.firestoned.io/host-controller for every host, and the class and endpoint under faubourg.firestoned.io/host-provider-spec for a bootstrapped one only, so a host switched to adopted keeps its spec. Reads its health from the one Provider carrying the host label (ADR-0003, ADR-0007, ADR-0009, ADR-0011).

Requests a day's token for the host Provider's ServiceAccount (TokenRequest), as faubourg-bootstrap with a 10-minute projected token; bounded by RBAC and the faubourg-provider-tokens admission policy to provider ServiceAccounts of one class, at most a day, no audience or binding (ADR-0011).
The kubelet pulls the controller and bootstrap images by digest; the admission policy admits only the bootstrap digest the operator applied (ADR-0008, ADR-0012).
The operator verifies the install file's and the images' signatures, sets the API server address, and applies it (ADR-0012).

flows.name: Add a host to a zone
flows.description: From a new Host object to a host banlieue can place VMs on.

transitions.description: Operator creates the SSH Secret and a Host with zoneRef.
Host controller checks the zone and the External class, applies the host's Provider, waits for banlieue to give it an identity, then creates the bootstrap Job; phase Bootstrapping.
The Job's pod mounts that host's Secret(s) and the script source.
The Job mints the provider's first token, verifies the host key, places the script if absent or changed, and runs sudo -n /opt/faubourg/install.sh with the credential on stdin.
The install script installs the credential where banlieue's provider reads it; the Provider carries faubourg's zone labels (ADR-0011).
The host-resident provider starts, renews its Lease and publishes its failure domain.
Provider Ready and heartbeat Alive: Host Ready; banlieue may place VMs on it.

metadata.project: faubourg: availability zones over banlieue's Cloud Hypervisor hosts
metadata.phase: faubourg-api types and the controller's pure functions (phase machine, Provider health, bootstrap Job builder) exist, with the bootstrap admission policy; the reconcilers and the bootstrap image are planned (roadmap 01).
